subtitle: 템 떴다고 신난 대가, 20골드도 안 통했다

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
상트라제 짝꿍 장트라제다!
합쳐서 술트라제 만든다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle 3/4 view cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal Zul'Farrak sandstone tile ground touch. On the left, an ecstatic Undead Paladin with sparkling eyes holds a small chibi one-handed sword and points toward a glowing rare chibi one-handed sword drop beside a defeated cute 2.5-head chibi SD Zul'Farrak troll boss in the back. On the right, a Skyborn Mage with her staff slung on her back watches calmly.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
나도 심심해서 굴렸는데?
어라, 내가 먹어버렸네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-angle cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sandstone floor shadow. On the left, a cheeky grinning Gnome Rogue with daggers sheathed at her waist holds up a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold die showing round dot pips only (no digits) as golden loot sparkles land on her. On the right, the Undead Paladin freezes mid-cheer with wide shocked eyes.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
20골드 줄게, 제발 넘겨줘!
나 진짜 술트라제 간절해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Diagonal over-the-shoulder low-angle cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal ground shadow. On the left, the teary-eyed Undead Paladin with all weapons sheathed kneels forward pleadingly while offering a tied brown leather pouch overflowing with round gold coins. On the right, the Gnome Rogue stands smugly with daggers sheathed and arms crossed.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
저도 이거 보고 온 거라
못 줘요~ 먼저 갑니다!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle dynamic cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal sand swirl. On the right, the Gnome Rogue with daggers sheathed winks and waves casually over her shoulder as a swirling gray Vanish smoke puff erupts around her feet while she bolts away. On the left, the stunned Undead Paladin reaches out empty-handed.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
너무 신나서 티를 내니까
일부러 굴려서 뺏어 갔지.
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium 3/4 shot cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, the Skyborn Mage with her staff slung on her back points a bare finger in deadpan bluntness. On the right, the Undead Paladin slumps on her knees with empty hands and drooping shoulders.

Extreme big close-up bust-up cute 2.5-head chibi SD gag cut filling 80 percent of the frame height on a pure #FFFFFF background. Centered dead-on, the Undead Paladin's pale face freezes in silent existential horror with blank white eyes, jaw dropped wide open, and a tiny translucent chibi ghost soul drifting upward out of her head.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
교훈 하나 기억해 둬.
인던에선 절대 좋아하지 마.
cuts.visual_prompt: Front-quarter finale cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal ground touch. On the left, a serious Human Warlock holding a small purple spellbook lectures sternly with a raised finger while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD floating purple Voidwalker companion nods gravely beside her. On the right, the Undead Paladin lies face-down deflated on the floor.
